fishing: WHEN: Sun Oct 18 prefer early morning light before NE winds build 15-20 kt (Small Craft Advisory through Mon night); residual dirty water from prior systems still challenging. PASSES-BEACH: limited reports due to wind; possible snook/reds. LEMON BAY: redfish & trout on flats, snook around docks/mangroves (Fishin Franks / local). NEARSHORE: weather-limited, few opportunities. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pilchards, cutbait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from and offshore of Southwest Florida (incl. in/offshore Sarasota, offshore Hillsborough). No fish kills or respiratory irritation reported over the past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~20 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, latest sample). No advisory. Palm Island also GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte ~2 customers out; Sarasota recent small isolated (no major Englewood spike; aggregators ~Oct 17-18).
